gen-dafont-quantum-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Quantum spaces its letters out generously, with open mouths and short ascenders. Mochiy Pop One brings a very large lowercase eye and strokes that look laser-cut at a single width.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Loose, spacious and a little techy, with short ascenders. Mochiy Pop P One pushes the gaps between letters wider still, so next to Quantum it all feels loose and friendly.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-montserrat-underli: Clean and spacious, Quantum spreads its letters out with open mouths and short ascenders. Montserrat Underline brings breathing counters and round bowls of uniform weight, so paragraphs should flow without snagging.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-mozilla-headline: Quantum keeps its stroke width constant and its letterfit loose, giving headings a clean, techy look with compressed ascenders. Mozilla Headline handles the text, with big-bodied lowercase and a splayed c terminal.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-mozilla-text: Quantum gives its bowls and stems matching weight, spaced loosely, with open mouths and short ascenders. The standout: tall, bold-looking lowercase in Mozilla Text, flared at the terminals.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-nobile: Quantum builds its capitals from lines of one constant thickness, with loose spacing and compressed ascenders. Nobile then reads smoothly across paragraphs, its lowercase sitting close to cap height.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-nokora: Spacious, crisp and a little futuristic up top. What stands out is how Quantum keeps its pen pressure and angle constant while Nokora lays a thick, dark stripe of lowercase across every line.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Noto Kufi Arabic reads modern and clean, with a welcoming c. Make Quantum small and its stitched-thread strokes fade, while blowing up the body would leave capitals barely above the lowercase.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-noto-sans: Quantum gives every part of a letter the same visual mass, loosely spaced, with short ascenders. Noto Sans takes the text, its lowercase filling most of the letter height.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Noto Sans Adlam keeps its curve endings well apart, and its lowercase c, s and z stand tall and full. Quantum, cut from one gauge of tubing, sets the tone above, so the two share a clean, spacious look.
